question: KRE-074/M6: account backend có thể lưu durable match snapshot/outcome/reward0 và preference đúng owner qua retry/kill/restart, với bounded worker và history CLI chưa?
scope: Backend/worker/owned-channel preference seam only, method=test. Chưa native serving integration, không đóng M6.

findings.summary: Schema3/backend match snapshot với key instance/room/round, atomic outcomes/reason/exits và reward0; normalized duplicate retry returns old record, conflicting same key rejects. History CLI reads account/room; migration preserves old account/session/profile/audit.
findings.limits: No client result persistence/native relogin or nonzero rewards. Trusted service must retain stable event/time/key; backend API is not a wire contract.

findings.summary: Actual SIGKILL after start commit preserves one open row then startup cancels once; kill after result commit preserves same outcome. Same transaction cancellation/epoch/session/audit rollback, DB busy/failed writes and idempotent retry tested with real DB.
findings.limits: Component/backend only; not yet commit-before-native-reply, serving kill/recovery, production backup/restore or match resume.

findings.summary: Normal bounded Worker persistence jobs reject full/expired/dropped queue, report Busy, recover lost committed reply using same key, live-auth lane refuses writes. Session-owned preference revision and post-await current-channel recheck keep account identity distinct.31isolated tests/28DBs and170workspace tests pass.
findings.limits: No room UI/character wire integration or full M6 closure from backend tests. Current supported0/1 stats/entitlement remain serving responsibility.
